title: Mega Reality TV Trivia-Easy to Extra Hard
blurb: 150 questions on reality television shows, hosts, and stars.

items.clue: Fox reality series formerly judged by Nigel Lythgoe and Mary Murphy is called "So You Think You Can" what?

What popular Bravo TV show, started in 2006, features cast members such as Tamra Judge and Kelly Dodd from Orange County?
accept: The Real Housewives of Orange County
